title: [destination-clickhouse] is not syncing data to the main tables but only creating the internal tables

destination-clickhouse

### Connector Version

v1.0.0

### What step the error happened?

During the sync

### Relevant information

comments.author: abhishekgahlot2

comments.author: davinchia
comments.body:
Hi @abhishekgahlot2, unfortunately this is pushed back to another 6 weeks or so, although Clickhouse still remains at the top of our 'Destinations-to-certify' list!

There are two main reasons for this, and I want to give folks a good explanation instead of merely telling everyone to 'wait': 

1) Internally we felt Airbyte was behind in the datalake domain and decided to focus our efforts on making taking the current Iceberg Destination and making it great. This is now available with the `s3-data-lake` Destination.

2) The current Airbyte flow includes creating raw tables in the Destination. This was originally conceived with the 'purest' form of ELT in mind - each user has a copy of the raw data and can theoretically fall back to this data if needed. This hasn't worked well in practice - the raw tables are poorly documented so it's been challenging to help everyone use them successfully. More importantly, this also added a non-trivial amount of storage and processing costs when delivering the final data driving up Airbyte total cost of owernship. Instead of moving Clickhouse onto the current approach (and incurring tech debt), we spent some time investigating and planning out a new way of loading data that no longer requires the raw tables. We estimate this is 2x - 4x faster and cheaper, and are planning to roll this out to all certified Destinations, including Clickhouse when we certify it.

Hopefully this sheds some light on the great work the team is doing. I really appreciate all the patience everyone has shown us; thank you!
